name: Jennifer
description: Jennifer is a sweet 2 months old Labrador that is patiently waiting to find a new forever home. This girl really enjoys being able to go outside to run and play, but won't hesitate to play up a storm in the house if she has all of her favorite toys.

name: Sophia
description: Sophia here and I'm looking for my forever home to live out the best years of my life. I am full of energy. Everyday I'm learning new things, like how to walk on a leash, go potty outside, bark and play with toys and I still need some practice.

name: Woody
description: Woody is a handsome 3 1/2 year old boy. Woody does know basic commands and is a smart pup. Since he is on the stronger side, he will learn a lot from your training. Woody will be happier when he finds a new family that can spend a lot of time with him.

name: Scarlett
description: Scarlett is a happy, playful girl who will make you laugh and smile. She forms a bond quickly and will make a loyal companion and a wonderful family dog or a good companion for a single individual too since she likes to hang out and be with her human.

name: Katrine
description: Katrine is a beautiful girl. She is as soft as the finest velvet with a thick lush fur. Will love you until the last breath she takes as long as you are the one. She is picky about her affection. She loves cuddles and to stretch into your hands for a deeper relaxations.

name: Timmy
description: Timmy is an adorable grey british shorthair male. He loves to play and snuggle. He is neutered and up to date on age appropriate vaccinations. He can be chatty and enjoys being held. Timmy has a lot to say and wants a person to share his thoughts with.

name: Freddie
description: Freddie is a little shy at first, but very sweet when he warms up. He likes playing with shoe strings and bottle caps. He is quick to learn the rhythms of his human’s daily life. Freddie has bounced around a lot in his life, and is looking to find his forever home.

name: Charly
description: This cute boy, Charly, is three years old and he likes adults and kids. He isn’t fond of many other dogs, so he might do best in a single dog home. Charly has lots of energy, and loves to run and play. We think a fenced yard would make him very happy.

name: Max
description: Max is a curious 1 month old Beagle puppy with a nose that never stops working. He loves sniffing around the yard, chasing leaves and wagging his tail at everyone he meets. Max will grow into a loyal and cheerful companion for an active family.

name: Luna
description: Luna is a tiny Siamese girl with striking blue eyes and a big voice. She loves to chat with her humans and follows them from room to room. Luna enjoys feather toys and warm laps, and she is looking for a calm home where she can grow up surrounded by love.

name: Rocky
description: Rocky is a confident and intelligent 4 year old German Shepherd. He knows many commands, walks nicely on a leash and loves learning new tricks. Rocky needs an experienced owner who can give him daily exercise, training and a job to do.

name: Bella
description: Bella is a gentle giant with a fluffy tabby coat and adorable ear tufts. She is calm, affectionate and gets along well with children and other cats. Bella loves to be brushed and will happily spend her evenings purring next to you on the couch.

name: Oscar
description: Oscar is a playful 3 months old Dachshund with long floppy ears and a brave little heart. He loves digging in blankets, playing tug of war and napping in sunny spots. Oscar is learning his first commands and is eager to please his new family.

name: Milo
description: Milo is a friendly ginger boy with bright amber eyes and a playful spirit. He loves chasing laser dots, climbing cat trees and watching birds from the window. Milo is neutered, litter trained and ready to bring lots of sunshine into your home.

name: Daisy
description: Daisy is a happy 2 year old Corgi with a big smile and even bigger ears. She is smart, social and loves playing fetch in the park. Daisy gets along with kids and other dogs and would be a perfect addition to a family that enjoys long walks.

name: Simba
description: Simba is an energetic 1 month old Bengal kitten with a beautiful spotted coat. He is fearless, curious and always ready for an adventure. Simba loves climbing, pouncing on toys and exploring every corner, so he needs a home with plenty of space to play.
